title: Network delay time
statement: Directed edges [u, v, w] give a travel time w ≥ 0 from u to v, nodes 1…n. A signal starts at k. Return the time for all nodes to receive it, or −1 if some never do.
hints: Single-source shortest paths with non-negative weights.
The answer is the largest shortest-path distance.

solution.explanation: Dijkstra with a binary heap and lazy deletion (skip stale entries where d > dist[u]). It's correct because with non-negative weights, the smallest tentative distance can never be improved later: anything else would pass through a node at least as far away.
